execution_environment.root_identity_policy: canonical absolute path; no direct/ancestor symlinks; mode 0700; launch uid/device/inode retained

source_snapshot_policy.cleanup: unlink exact files, then rmdir exact directories; no recursion
source_snapshot_policy.scope: one domain/problem snapshot tree per candidate

execution_environment.tmpdir_cleanup: EXIT trap with pinned /usr/bin/rmdir; no recursion

v3_infrastructure_diagnostic.inspection_scope: all v3 scheduler rows, OOM scheduler resource rows, and only non-success v3 Slurm logs

memory_per_cpu.reason: v3 scheduler OOM at 512G; batch MaxRSS and MaxVMSize are pinned above

task_timeout_seconds.reason: v3 translator exceeded its 7200-second source limit; task/log/accounting evidence is pinned above

temporary_storage.cleanup: per-task EXIT trap using pinned rmdir only
temporary_storage.reason: v3 ENOSPC while the translator serialized output.sas

time_limit.reason: preserve scheduler headroom for doubled source limit
